Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Key Largo hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 9 of the 15 Key Largo hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 3, the hotel's own site at 2, Kiwi.com at 1, Traveluro at 1, Tripadvisor.com at 1 and Vio.com at 1. These are the Key Largo rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 9 of the 14 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 4, the hotel's own site at 2, Kiwi.com at 1, Traveluro at 1 and Vio.com at 1 (a tie counts for each site). At the other 5, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: the study also counts the 1 named below that are not listed on this page. Each hotel below shows every site's all-in price. Taxes and fees at Key Largo hotels

At the 9 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 12% ($23 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 11% at Bayside Inn Key Largo to 13% at Seafarer Resort and Beach. At 5 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
